dedup: Exclude any identical (seed,seat,t) in the complete 152-row older original registry, all terminal_direction realized roots, all three paired_response_prefix registries and the two recent original_response intervention windows. Also exclude same-terrain and seat prior short public hash or physical prefix hash, plus duplicate within-batch histories. Accept t before consuming archived actions[t]; no future state, income, result or teacher label in enrollment. Bind both exact actions and complete prefix.
eligibility: First four distinct seeds ascending in the thirteen original model-training maps. Source historical candidate seat equals map-index mod 2. Two disjoint inclusive 28-turn windows. Select first qualifying public tick in each window. Require a living own collector with cargo >=20, different legal moves and different destination distances from the nearest own base. First 14 ticks per window accept only a choice where exactly one proposed destination is an own base. Last 14 ticks also accept route discrepancies if the collector currently lies 1–5 toroidal steps from a friendly base. If multiple focal workers qualify on the same tick prioritize immediate-base discrepancy, then largest cargo, then smallest uid lexicographically. Keep entire naturally emitted team action and record every cochange. No replacement maps or windows.
learning: Two public signed features x0=min(cargo/100,1)*(parent_dest_distance-student_dest_distance)/2 and x1=min(cargo/100,1)*(I(student lands on friendly base)-I(parent lands on friendly base)). One regularized logistic neuron with bias and a parallel intercept-only model. Start at zero; exactly 24 Newton iterations; loss terrain-equal mean BCE plus 0.5*L2 norm squared including intercept. Target sign of student-minus-parent official terminal margin; exclude exact ties from training but evaluate all played pairs. No directional assumption. Leave one whole map out; require both classes in each training fold. Choose student only for p>0.5. Report both constant arms, intercept-only and trained model, official margin, W/D/L, both physical teams deposits and tree cash at 8/24/terminal. Advancement to collecting independent labels requires all folds estimable, strictly positive held map-level margin vs both parent-only and intercept-only on >=3 of the same maps, positive overall terrain-equal margin gain vs parent and no win-count decrease. Positive outcome permits replication only. No surrogate labels for other commands.
limitations: Up to 8 cases from four exposed training terrains. Any held map refers only to this fit, not prior model training. Whole-team differences may include other workers. No proven causal attribution to a single carrier. A single native draw per action; unchanged/no-support windows remain reported and cannot be replaced.
sampling: One original natural warmup per source, real .58 s wall clock at T1 with default unseeded sampling. Retarget tracker to actual archived historical command every tick through each root. Save original fresh root response and the complete post-decision tracker, adaptive costs, counters and Python/NumPy/Torch RNG snapshot before retargeting that root to carry on to the next sampled historical position. Restore a separate identical copy for each arm. After the common enemy root action original responds naturally independently within each branch. Mark a single native draw per action and retain every terminal. At t only learner action differs; from t+1 use 8da4 for both arms without exception. Source index mod 2 selects dedicated core 0 or 1, scheduling maps 0 then 2 on core 0; 1 then 3 on core 1. Arms serial, parent first iff (map index+window index) is even. Preserve full opponent orders, per-step true clocks, depth and fallback, never discard poorly timed outcomes. No additional trials.
